hypothesis: Capital-allocation/entry-admission alpha: within the accepted-helper source-priority allocator, maintain an independent fixed-$4k raw-source shadow book against SPY and QQQ. When both benchmark-relative equity curves remain strictly below their own high-water marks for 21 consecutive observable trading sessions, quarantine only that source's new entries before daily top1 selection so healthy lower-priority sources can backfill; continue the shadow book and re-enable only when both curves recover the high-water marks frozen at quarantine. Keep source priority, ranking, five accepted 1.25x scalars, hold, cooldown, costs, execution envelope, exits, and core behavior fixed.
next_retry_requires: A genuinely new independent signal or data source, or at least 58 newly settled forward allocator source decisions under the unchanged frozen policy accumulated without outcome inspection.
notes: Blind preflight passed with 115 affected settled decisions across 7 source families, 22 triggers, 59.55 percent minimum survival, and zero contract or benchmark gaps. Full-system aggregate EV fell from 13.1229 to 12.9658, incremental PnL was negative 5580.25, and no window passed both EV and PnL improvement. Drawdown improved in mid_weak and old_thin but late_strong EV, PnL, and drawdown regressed. DSR was not computable in all windows; historical allocator selection risk is high and live_eligible is false. Rejected policy wiring was rolled back; replay patches and hashes are in data/experiments/exp-20260715-001/reproduction.json.
